compliance.headline: Why you can use this when you can't use ChatGPT
compliance.body: Most firms do not allow client files in public chat tools. {{productName}} is built so the files stay under your control.
compliance.point-1: Your files stay on your computer. {{productName}} searches them locally before any AI request is sent.
compliance.point-2: When you use cloud AI, your question and needed context go straight to your own provider account, not through {{productName}} servers.
compliance.point-3: You get a simple security one-pager to hand to the person who reviews new tools.
compliance.modal-body: One-pager coming: data flow, encryption, SOC 2 status.

ai.mode-note: Either way, your source files stay on your machine. Cloud AI sends your question and needed context to your own AI account. On-device AI keeps even the question on this computer.

pay-modal.title: Pay as you go, with your own key
pay-modal.body: You get an API key from the AI company you pick: ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini. You pay them directly, only for what you actually use, usually a few cents per question. {{productName}} never charges you for AI. Your prompts go straight from your machine to that provider, not through {{productName}} servers.

local-modal.title: On-device AI, explained
local-modal.body: On-device AI runs on your own computer. It's free and fully private, so your files and questions stay on this machine. It's a one-time download of about 2.5 GB. It's good at answering questions across lots of files, though not as strong on complex reasoning. You can switch to cloud AI any time.

welcome.title: Welcome to {{productName}}
welcome.subtitle: The private place your firm lives, that answers you back.
welcome.body-1: {{productName}} keeps your clients' files, documents, and imported email on your own machine. Ask a question across your whole firm, so that you get a cited answer you can verify. Your files stay real files in a folder you control.
welcome.body-2: Setup takes about 2 minutes. I'll help you pick a folder for your work, connect your AI provider account (optional), and run your first workflow.
welcome.step-1: Step 1. Pick a folder for your work
welcome.step-2: Step 2. Connect your AI provider account (optional)

workspace.title: Pick a folder for your work
workspace.subtitle: Your client files stay on your machine, in a folder you control.
workspace.body-1: This is where your client work will live: real Word documents, PDFs, and notes in a normal folder on your hard drive. Nothing is uploaded to our servers. Pick a location that's easy to find and easy to back up.
workspace.body-2: Pro tip: a folder inside Dropbox, iCloud, or OneDrive syncs across devices, but that also means your files sit with that provider. For client-confidential work, keep the folder local.
workspace.body-3: The next screen will let you actually pick the folder. For now, just confirm you understand what we're about to ask.

apikey.title: Add an AI provider key
apikey.subtitle: Optional, but you'll need one to use the AI features.
apikey.body-1: {{productName}} is a "bring your own key" tool. You sign up with an AI provider directly and paste their account key here. Your keys are stored in your operating system's secure keychain, never sent to us, and used from your computer when it talks to your provider.
apikey.body-2: The fastest way to get started is with <s>Anthropic Claude</s>:
apikey.step-signup: Sign up (free, $5 in credits to start)
apikey.step-copy-key: Copy the key (starts with <c>sk-ant-</c>) and paste it below
apikey.skip-hint: You can skip this and add a key later in Settings, AI Account Keys.

demo.title: Run your first workflow
demo.subtitle: See a real deliverable come together in seconds.
demo.body-1: The fastest way to see what {{productName}} does is to run a workflow. Pick any template from the Workflows tab, answer the questions it asks, and watch it produce a finished Word document in your folder.
demo.step-2: Pick any template that fits your firm
demo.outcome: You'll get back finished work as real Word documents, ready to open, edit, and send to clients.
demo.populate-toggle: Add {{count}} sample client files to get started
demo.populate-help: Adds finished examples so you can see what a completed workflow looks like before running your first real project. You can delete them any time.
demo.copy-error: Could not copy samples: {{error}}. Don't worry, you're still in.

disk-encryption.title: One thing to check: your disk encryption
disk-encryption.body: {{productName}} keeps your documents as normal files in your workspace folder, on your machine. If the laptop is lost or stolen, your operating system's full-disk encryption is what protects them. It takes a minute to confirm it is on.
disk-encryption.check-windows: Windows: Settings, then Privacy & security, then Device encryption (or search for BitLocker). It should say On.
disk-encryption.check-macos: Mac: System Settings, then Privacy & Security, then FileVault. It should say FileVault is turned on.
disk-encryption.check-linux: Linux: most installers offer LUKS full-disk encryption. Check your distribution's disk settings, or run lsblk and look for a crypt entry.

api-key-card.title: Next step: add your AI account key
api-key-card.description: {{productName}} uses your own account key from Anthropic, OpenAI, or Google, so your AI usage goes straight to your provider with no markup from us. Your {{productName}} plan covers the software.
api-key-card.keys-local: Account keys are stored locally on your computer. Never sent to us.

step-1.body: Click the button below to open <s>{{dashboard}}</s> in your browser. You'll need to sign in (or sign up) to get to the keys page.

step-2-ollama.body: Download Ollama for your OS, then in a terminal run <c>ollama pull llama3.2</c> (or any model you want). {{productName}} auto-detects Ollama on the next step.

welcome.title: Welcome to {{productName}}
welcome.description: A couple of optional things, both off by default. Skip if you'd rather not.
welcome.email-optin-label: Email me launch updates, tips, and discount codes
welcome.email-optin-help: Real updates only, no drip campaigns, no weekly newsletters. Unsubscribe any time. Goes straight to the {{productName}} team.
welcome.telemetry-label: Help improve {{productName}} with anonymous usage stats
welcome.telemetry-help: Sends a random install ID, the app version, your platform, and lifecycle events (trial started, license activated, etc.). No content, no files, no AI prompts, no email. You can turn this off in Settings, Privacy.

api-key-explainer.privacy-body: That direct connection is what makes {{productName}} private: your prompts go straight from your machine to the provider you chose. {{productNamePossessive}} servers never see your work, your files, or your conversations.
api-key-explainer.what-is-body: An API key is like a password that lets your computer talk directly to an AI company (Anthropic, OpenAI, or Google). You create it on their site, paste it here once, and {{productName}} stores it in your operating system's secure keychain.

bridge.intro: Pick how you want to get into a firm. Then you can bring your existing clients over, choosing for each one whether to keep it private or share it with colleagues.
bridge.door-create-body: You become the admin and the first seat. Invite colleagues, share clients, set up single sign-on and the firm security.
bridge.door-join-body: Sign in to a firm that already exists and claim your seat. An admin sets you up first.
bridge.create-paid-note: The firm plan is a paid plan, separate from your solo license. Get it here, then claim your firm below:

prompt.title: Use {{productName}} with your firm
prompt.body: Bring colleagues in and share clients, or join a firm that already uses {{productName}}. Your private clients stay private.

prompt-preparation.title: Review private links
prompt-preparation.description_one: I found {{count}} private access link in the material for this AI request. I made a safe copy with the private parts hidden. Send that safe copy?
prompt-preparation.description_other: I found {{count}} private access links in the material for this AI request. I made a safe copy with the private parts hidden. Send that safe copy?

local.label: On your machine. No cloud AI
local.note: This runs on a local model ({{provider}}). No AI prompt or file is sent to a cloud AI.

direct.label: Sent to your {{provider}} account
direct.note: Sent straight from your machine to {{provider}} with your own account key. {{productName}} is not in between. {{provider}} receives the prompt and may keep it briefly for abuse monitoring; control training opt-out in your {{provider}} account.

demo.label: Browser demo. Do not use with client data
demo.note: In this online demo, messages pass through a shared {{productName}} relay. The desktop app never does this. Do not enter confidential or client information here.

checking.label: Checking AI destination
checking.note: {{productName}} is confirming where this request will go before sending.

none.label: No AI connected
none.note: Connect an AI provider to start getting answers.

local-pending.label: Local AI setting up
local-pending.note: Your on device AI is still downloading or starting up. Nothing has been sent anywhere. Check its progress in Settings, then try again.

privileged-matter.badge: Isolated client: outside connections are blocked so nothing can leave this client.
privileged-matter.title-manual: Network lockdown: network plugins and MCP servers are disabled.
privileged-matter.title-privileged-matter: On because the active client has network lockdown. Network plugins and MCP servers are disabled.
privileged-matter.title-local-only: On because On this computer only is selected. Network plugins and MCP servers are disabled.

retention.title: Deleted files
retention.subtitle: Choose what happens to recordings on this computer. Deletions are recorded in your audit log.

retention.mode-days-hint: The recording is removed on schedule. Transcript and notes stay.
retention.mode-summary-hint: Audio and transcript are removed once notes exist. Only the notes stay.
retention.sweep-errors: {{count}} items could not be removed. See the audit log.

connect.fde-warning: Full-disk encryption is off on this machine. {{productName}} encrypts your mail, but enabling FileVault (macOS) or BitLocker (Windows) adds a second layer of protection if your device is stolen.

workspace.demo-preview-note: Open the desktop app to read the full message.
workspace.select-email-empty: Select an email from the list to read it here.
workspace.select-email-after-error: Fix the problem, then choose an email.
workspace.ask-hint: Answers use imported email and openable citations.
workspace.ask-memory-disabled: Memory is not enabled. Enable it in Settings to use AI search.

workspace.ask-no-client-email: No email is filed to this client yet.
workspace.ask-no-client-email-suffix: above, or file emails to this client with File.
workspace.first-connect-callout: Email connected. Try searching by name, topic, or deadline.
workspace.sync-stalled: This is taking longer than expected. Sync is still running in the background.

viewer.privilege-note: Excluded from AI unless you turn on Include sensitive content.

viewer.attachments-open-in-mail: Open in mail app to download attachments.
viewer.search-repair-pending: Search is updating. This email will not appear in search results until it is ready.

no-accounts.title: Connect email

control.on-body: This workspace's files are encrypted at rest. {{productName}} decrypts them transparently, so your work is unchanged.
control.locked-note: This vault is locked. Reopen the workspace to unlock it with your recovery phrase.

ceremony.cannot-recover-warning: {{productName}} cannot recover this for you. If you lose this phrase and your device's keychain, your encrypted files will be permanently inaccessible.
ceremony.confirm-prompt: Confirm you've saved the phrase. Enter the words at these positions:

enable.title: Encrypt this workspace
enable.subtitle: AES-256 at rest, transparent in {{productName}}
enable.detail: When enabled, every document file in this workspace is stored as ciphertext on disk. {{productName}} decrypts them transparently so your workflow is unchanged.
enable.bullet-names-visible: File names and folder structure remain visible
enable.bullet-phrase-once: A 24-word recovery phrase is generated once. You must save it.
enable.bullet-no-recovery: If you lose the phrase and the keychain, files cannot be recovered
enable.bullet-firm-escrow: A firm admin can recover this vault via escrow
enable.ceremony-subheading: Write it down somewhere safe. Shown once only.
enable.escrow-notice: A firm admin will be able to recover this vault on your behalf using the firm's escrow key. This is in addition to your personal recovery phrase.
enable.encrypting-subtitle: This may take a moment for large workspaces.
enable.done-subtitle: All files are now protected at rest.

locked.title: Vault locked
locked.subtitle: This workspace is encrypted and the key is not on this machine.
locked.explanation: Enter your 24-word recovery phrase to unlock this vault. {{productName}} will restore the key to your keychain so you can open this workspace normally from now on.
locked.phrase-hint: Recovery phrases are 24 words separated by spaces.
locked.escape-hatch: Turn off vault and decrypt files
locked.error-invalid-phrase: That phrase has an invalid format. Check each word and try again.
locked.error-recovery-failed: That phrase is valid, but it does not match this vault. Make sure you are using the correct recovery phrase.

escape-hatch.title: Decrypt this workspace and turn off the vault
escape-hatch.description: This will convert every encrypted file back to a normal, unencrypted file on this disk. The vault will be disabled and removed from this workspace.
escape-hatch.warning-title: After this, at-rest protection reverts to OS disk encryption only.
escape-hatch.warning-body: Your files will be readable by any process that has access to this folder. Make sure your operating system's full-disk encryption is enabled if you handle sensitive documents.
escape-hatch.working: Decrypting files this may take a moment for large workspaces.
escape-hatch.done-message: All files have been decrypted and the vault has been removed. Your files are normal unencrypted files on disk.

review.title: Review notes
review.approve-description: Nothing is added anywhere until you approve each item.

speakers.title: Who is speaking?
speakers.name-placeholder: Type a name for this voice
speakers.applied: Speaker names updated in the transcript.
speakers.privacy-note: Voice profiles are stored only on this computer, encrypted, and only for this client. You can delete them from the client's page at any time.
speakers.consent-label: Naming a new voice creates a voice profile of your client, stored encrypted on this computer. I confirm the client agreed to this.
speakers.consent-biometric-note: Some states (for example Illinois, Texas, and Washington) treat a voiceprint as regulated biometric data with its own consent rules. Check your state's rules. This is general guidance, not legal advice.
speakers.consent-save-failed: Couldn't save the consent record, so no voice profile was created. Please try again.

pill.local-tooltip: Nothing has left this machine. The audio is written straight to your disk.
pill.processing: Writing your meeting notes you can keep working
pill.write-error: Recording can't continue. Disk is full.

tab.empty-body: Recordings, notes, and transcripts stay with this client.
tab.record-note: Recorded on this computer. Nothing is uploaded.
tab.scan-error-body: Your recordings are still on this computer.

entry.recording-incomplete: This recording didn't finish saving, so there's no audio to transcribe or write notes from. This can happen if the computer ran out of disk space while recording.
entry.notes-failed-timeout: Notes couldn't be written. The AI provider didn't respond in time. Your recording and transcript are safe.
entry.notes-failed-error: Notes couldn't be written. The AI provider returned an error. Your recording and transcript are safe.
entry.notes-failed-blocked: Notes need your AI provider, but Local-only mode is blocking it. Connect a local model to write this meeting's notes, or, if you'd rather, turn off Local-only mode in Settings → Privacy.
entry.transcript-failed-not-installed: Transcription couldn't run. The voice engine isn't installed on this computer yet. Your recording is safe.
entry.transcript-failed-timeout: Transcription couldn't finish. The voice engine didn't respond in time. Your recording is safe.
entry.transcript-failed-error: Transcription couldn't finish. The voice engine returned an error. Your recording is safe.
entry.no-audio: No audio is saved for this meeting.
entry.no-one-spoke: No one spoke in the saved transcript.
entry.summary-empty: No summary text is available yet.
entry.delete-audio-confirm-body: The audio file is deleted from this computer. The transcript and notes stay.
entry.delete-audio-confirm-body-no-transcript: There is no transcript and no notes for this meeting yet. Deleting the audio now permanently removes the only copy of the meeting. This cannot be undone.

recipients.title: Recipients
recipients.description: Pick who gets what. Nothing sends until review.
recipients.saved: Saved locally. Nothing has been sent.

send.title: Send meeting items
send.privacy-note: Review first. Sends by your email. {{productName}} never receives files.
send.needs-review: Mark the meeting reviewed before sending anything.
send.no-items: Choose at least one recipient for an available meeting item.
send.local-only-blocked: Local-only mode is on, so email sending is off.
send.missing: These planned items are not ready yet: {{artifacts}}.
send.confirm-privacy: Sends through {{account}}. This is when files leave this computer.
send.send-again-warning: {{artifact}} was already sent. Confirm you want to send it again.
send.sent-with-errors_one: Tried {{total}} item; {{failed}} failed. Check the send log.
send.sent-with-errors_other: Tried {{total}} items; {{failed}} failed. Check the send log.
send.email-body:
Hi,

Attached is the {{artifact}} from {{client}}'s meeting: {{title}}.

Sent from my connected email account after review.

consent.title: Record this meeting?
consent.two-party-note: Your state requires everyone's consent. Suggested ask: "I'd like to record this for my notes. Is that alright with everyone?"
consent.checkbox: I have the consent I need
consent.mac-permission-title: macOS needs your permission to hear meeting audio.
consent.mac-permission-body: This lets the app record what plays on this Mac. It is saved to your disk and nowhere else.
consent.two-party-note-unknown: If your state requires everyone’s consent, ask before you record. Suggested ask: "I’d like to record this for my notes. Is that alright with everyone?"
consent.low-disk-warning: Low disk space. Long recordings may not fit.

notice.default-script: Quick note before we start. I'm recording this meeting for my notes. The recording stays on my computer. Is that alright with everyone?
notice.consent-script-hint: {{productName}} checks the transcript for this later.
notice.unverified-title: No spoken notice was found in the first 5 minutes. Choose what happened.
notice.resolve-missed: Notice was given, transcription missed it
notice.quarantine-body: Strict policy keeps this meeting in review until you resolve the notice.
notice.invite-disclosure: I'll be recording this meeting for my notes. The recording stays on my computer. If you have any questions, please ask before we begin.
notice.chat-notice: Just so everyone knows: I'm recording this meeting for my notes. The recording stays on my computer.
notice.settings-standard-desc: Every notice step is offered and the spoken notice is detected from the transcript. A meeting with no detected notice is flagged for review.
notice.settings-strict-desc: A meeting whose spoken notice isn't detected stays in review until you resolve it. Nothing is ever deleted or stopped automatically.
notice.settings-strict-recommend: If your state requires everyone's consent to record, we recommend Strict.
notice.settings-script-placeholder: Leave blank to use the built-in wording.

templates.title: Meeting templates
templates.description: Fill a firm layout from this transcript, then review it before it is saved.
templates.internal-note: This note stays inside {{productName}}. It cannot be saved as a client-facing note.

notice-card.meet-fallback: Google Meet needs a signed-in account, so the notice card can't join. Say the recording notice aloud instead.

notice-card.pill-window-open-failed: Notice card window couldn't open. Say the notice aloud.

notice-card.card-line-1: The recording stays on this computer
notice-card.card-footer: This card leaves when recording ends

notice-card.unsupported-fallback: This meeting link isn't one the notice card can join, so say the recording notice aloud instead.

notice-card.settings-evidence-both: Both a spoken notice and full-meeting card presence
